Q1: The unblock judge asked for `stable` explicitly, and that is how this repo routes workflow fixes: heal issues carry `Target branch: stable`, and `forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml` carries the change to `main`. `ci.yml` and `lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml` both run on PRs into `stable`, so no check is skipped. The `support_ref_mismatch` risk in the note does not apply: `implement_heal_preflight.sh` runs only on the heal route (`HEAL_ROUTE=true`), and this is a normal issue. The underlying bug, an exported `GIT_DIR` overriding `git -C`, was also fixed in #7193 (`changelog.d/7193-heal-preflight-support-git-dir.md`).
Q2: The spec only covers the sweep's support checkout (`workflow-templates/ai-review.yml` lines 79-85, `path: .security-hold-support`), and the plan must stay surgical. The renderer rewrite should therefore target only that checkout, keyed on its `path:`, and leave the `provider-outage-resume` checkout (line 118, `ref: stable`, `GH_TOKEN: secrets.GH_PAT`) as it is. That job has the same moving-ref exposure, which stays out of scope for this issue. If a human wants it pinned later, the same renderer rule can be extended to `.provider-outage-support` in a separate change.
